summary:
Farm-Orbit is an innovative smart agriculture platform designed to help farmers make better decisions using modern technology. The main aim of this project is to make farming smarter, easier, and more efficient by providing useful information and digital tools in one place.
The platform integrates AI-powered features to assist farmers with agricultural information and guidance. It also uses Leaflet Maps to provide interactive map functionality, helping users explore geographical locations. By combining artificial intelligence, web technologies, and mapping tools, Farm-Orbit aims to support farmers in understanding agricultural challenges and improving their farming practices.
Our vision is to connect technology with agriculture and contribute towards a smarter, more sustainable, and technology-driven future for farming.
details:
FarmOrbit is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform developed to help farmers make informed farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data. The platform provides agricultural insights, weather information, crop-related guidance, field monitoring, and interactive maps to help farmers understand changing environmental conditions.

FarmOrbit focuses on agricultural regions such as Haldia, Tamluk, and Purba Medinipur in West Bengal. It integrates NASA APIs to provide relevant environmental data and uses an AI-powered farming assistant to make agricultural information easier to understand. The platform also supports Hindi, English, and Bengali to make it accessible to more farmers.

The project is developed using React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, and Leaflet for interactive mapping. Our goal is to make NASA Earth observation data more useful and accessible to farmers and support smarter, more informed agricultural decisions.
